newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Discovery Airlines cancels New Zealand launch.
newsitem.headline: Discovery Airlines cancels New Zealand launch.

text.p: Discovery Airlines, formerly Value Airlines, said on Tuesday it had cancelled the launch of the airline, which was to have plied New Zealand domestic routes from late last year.
Discovery blamed the move on market conditions, the collapse of Kiwi International and the lack of what it said were effective predatory pricing and anti-trust laws.

Chief Executive and former Ansett pilot Phillip Maguire said Discovery would be left on ice "until such time as government can ensure the legislation is effective to encourage competition and choice for air travellers".
Maguire said the relationship between Air New Zealand and Ansett left the domestic market with a classic duopoly.
Discovery was scheduled to have started domestic services with Boeing 737 aircraft last November.
